newsitem.title: ITALY: IBCA affirms Italy's Imi ratings.
newsitem.headline: IBCA affirms Italy's Imi ratings.

text.p: European credit rating agency IBCA said on Thursday it had affirmed Istituto Mobiliare Italiano's (IMI) short-term credit rating at A1 plus.
It said in a statement it affirmed the long-term rating at AA minus and the individual rating A/B and legal 2.
IMI remained one of Italy's most profitable banks, thanks to broad diversification, good asset quality and tight cost control, it added.
"The bank has relatively low credit risk, mainly because its lending activities have been focused on large private and state-owned corporates," IBCA said.
"This was reflected in low loan loss provisions for 1996 and the low amount of doubtful loans as a percentage of total lending.
"The low risk weightings of IMI's assets give it very sound regulatory capital ratios and its liquidity is good," IBCA added.
